en: A black‑and‑white postcard-style photograph of a four‑storey urban villa or small palace on a broad, unpaved street. The building shows late 19th–early 20th century eclectic architecture with strong neoclassical influence: columned corner loggias, balustraded balconies, ornate cornices, and a steep, partly mansard roof with finials and railings. People in early 1900s clothing stand on the sidewalks, balconies, and entry steps. The façade has small street-level signs near the doors but they are too small to read clearly. Adjacent buildings in a similar historicist style are visible in the background.
